salon.sin_mesas: There are no tables yet. Go to "Edit floor plan" to add the first one.
salon.ayuda: Edit mode: drag the gold points to change the shape of the room. Tap the grey point in the middle of an edge to add a point to it or turn it into a curve (for rounded corners, circular bars, etc. - you can keep adjusting it afterwards by dragging the curve points). Double-click a gold point to delete it (if more than 3 remain). Drag the tables to place them.
salon.error_demasiados_puntos: The room already has too many points to curve another edge (maximum 40).
salon.confirmar_reiniciar: Reset the floor plan? All tables will be deleted and the shape goes back to a blank rectangle. This cannot be undone.
salon.error_guardar_forma: Could not save the room shape: {mensaje}
salon.error_reiniciar: Could not reset the floor plan: {mensaje}
salon.emp_hint: Each employee only sees the leads of the department you assign. You (Management) still see everything.
salon.emp_ninguno: You haven't added any employees yet.
salon.emp_confirmar_borrar: Delete this employee? They will no longer be able to log in to the CRM.
